subject: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>; Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, partners@bytewave.io
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Hi Sarah / ByteWave team —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Per our chat, the next step to unblock the POC is a focused technical workshop to walk through:

- VPC peering/PrivateLink options for the private deployment
- Network egress, NAT, and firewall expectations
- IAM design: cross-account roles, key handling, and least-privilege patterns
- Audit/logging expectations and retention to meet your compliance needs

Lauren (SE) and I would like to run a 90-minute session with your cloud engineers and whoever from security/procurement needs to be present for scope / acceptance criteria. Proposed slots (PST):

1) Wed Nov 18, 10:00–11:30am PST
2) Thu Nov 19, 1:00–2:30pm PST
3) Fri Nov 20, 8:00–9:30am PST

Can you confirm which of those works for Marcus (CISO) and your cloud team? I attached a one-pager agenda and a draft network diagram you shared during the discovery.

If procurement wants to join for a quick note on timelines/PO, Katie — happy to have you for the first 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0132
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-prep-agenda-v1.pdf, bytewave-network-diagram-draft.png
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@bytewave.io>, Katie Moore <katie.moore@bytewave.io>, eng-oncall@bytewave.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Diego —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Quick notes from our side:

- Marcus wants the session recorded and a short checklist for items we need to approve post-workshop.
- Fri Nov 20 at 8:00am PST conflicts with an all-hands; can you do Thu Nov 19 1:00pm?
- Our cloud team (I’ll loop in the oncall alias for the workshop) would like visibility into the slides at least 24 hours prior.
- Procurement: Katie can join but prefers 15–20 minutes at the start.

If Thu works, send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and the agenda PDF.

—Sarah
Sarah Liu
Principal Cloud Engineer | ByteWave
sarah.liu@bytewave.io
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, eng-oncall@bytewave.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Thanks Sarah — Thu Nov 19 1:00pm PST is good for me. I’ll be focused on the networking and IAM sections; Diego and I will split the runbook.

Proposed attendee list from Redwood:
- Diego Fernandez (AE) — kickoff + procurement notes
- Lauren Bishop (SE) — architecture walkthrough + demo hooks
- Neha Kapoor (Solutions Ops) — deployment timelines and config checklist
- Rachel Kim (Customer Success) — post-workshop acceptance criteria and next steps

I’ll upload the slide deck and a high-level runbook link to Drive by Wed Nov 18 1:00pm PST so your team can review. Any specific network diagrams you want us to expand on?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Katie Moore <katie.moore@bytewave.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@bytewave.io>, partners@bytewave.io
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Hi Diego —

Confirmed Thu Nov 19 1:00pm PST for procurement to join briefly. For logistics: we need an initial estimate of potential monthly egress costs and any IP ranges you expect traffic from (for firewall allow-lists). If you can surface those during the first 5–10 minutes, that helps speed PO discussions on our side.

Thanks,
Katie Moore
Procurement Manager | ByteWave
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>, Katie Moore <katie.moore@bytewave.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, eng-oncall@bytewave.io
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Great — I’ll send the invite for Thu Nov 19 1:00pm PST and include the Zoom link + recording permission. Lauren will present the network and IAM slides; I’ll cover procurement bullet points (egress estimate, IP ranges).

Note: attaching the invite (.ics) and the prep agenda. If Marcus wants the recording disabled, please confirm — we can also record but restrict access.

Attachments: workshop-invite.ics, redwood-prep-agenda-v1.pdf

Diego
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@bytewave.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>; Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bytewave.io>
Cc: Katie Moore <katie.moore@bytewave.io>, eng-oncall@bytewave.io, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Infra Integration Workshop (VPC / Networking / IAM) with ByteWave

Diego / Sarah —

Unfortunately I need to move our slot. An unexpected audit prep meeting conflicts with Thu Nov 19 at 1pm PST. Can we shift the workshop to Mon Nov 23 at 9:00am PST or Tue Nov 24 at 11:00am PST? Either works for security. Also, request that the agenda include a 10-minute segment at the end for evidence requirements we expect in a SOC2-type review.

If you can confirm one of those, I’ll update internal attendees. If not possible, list secondary times and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Marcus Hale
Chief Information Security Officer | ByteWave
On Mon, 15 Nov 2026 at 09:45 AM -08:00 Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:

> Thanks Marcus — appreciate the heads up. Lauren and I can do Mon Nov 23 9:00am PST. I’ll update the calendar invite and circulate the revised agenda (we’ll add a 10-minute SOC2 evidence checklist at the end).
>
> Quick ask for ByteWave eng: can your team paste any existing VPC peering or transit-gateway CIDR ranges into the shared drive document before the call? It will speed the session if we can annotate the network diagram in real time.
>
> Sending updated invite now.
>
> Diego
